name: kihyun-skills
description: Claude Code mods (hooks plugins) from Ki Hyun Park's skills repo.

plugins.name: thegraph-panel
plugins.description: While /thegraph runs: one line above the prompt with its steps and the signals that fired, and a button that opens a pane with a minute-by-minute heat map of the run over its latest log lines; the spinner and each turn's closing line carry the step and what the turn did.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Two rows above the prompt: model, effort, how fast the 5-hour limit is going (%/h) and today's cost, over gauges for context, the 5-hour window and the week, each limit marked where an even pace would be.
